review.note: Retracted in M21: the earthquake of 8:42 on 31 August 1926 destroyed or damaged 4,138 buildings in Horta and the villages around it, on Faial in the Azores, and killed nine people. It is a real event and a bad one, and nothing in this atlas follows from it. The brief names disasters without consequence as an expected retraction and this is one.
